name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (EUR)
oneLiner: EURSAFO is Spiko's EUR share of the Spiko/Amundi Smart Cash fund, a UCITS overnight-swap money-market vehicle authorized by the AMF.
collateral: EUR share class of the Spiko / Amundi Smart Cash fund using fully collateralized total-return swaps with tier-1 bank counterparties and collateral made of liquid financial instruments / money-market fund exposure.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share class; subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko fund-transfer rails at the published fund NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EURSAFO is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: EURSAFO is the EUR share class of Spiko's AMF-authorized UCITS fund. Tokens are minted by Spiko's daily-operator relayer contracts (two UUPS proxies) under a PermissionManager (custom RBAC), with a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (8/3) as the super-admin that controls upgrades and permission assignments.

controls.label: Spiko daily-operator minter contracts (two UUPS proxies)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295046, PermissionManager (0x344278aff…, ERC1967Proxy → PermissionManager impl) initialization logs (block 19690268) assign mint function (0x40c10f19) and burn (0x9dc29fac) access to 0xa0769f7a8fc65e47de93797b4e21c073c117fc80 and 0xe4880249745eac5f1ed9d8f7df844792d560e750. Both are UUPS proxies (impl 0x15ea0ec4, 'Token' contract) with owner() = 0x0 — operated as issuer backend relayers via the PermissionManager system.

controls.label: Spiko super-admin Safe (8/3, UUPS upgrade + permission admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295092, PermissionManager initialization log (block 19690268) assigns ADMIN group (group id 0) admin role to 0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea; masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 L2); threshold() = 3; getOwners() returned 8 addresses; getModules() = 0; guard slot = 0x0. ADMIN group controls upgradeToAndCall on both the Token proxy and PermissionManager proxy.

review.evidence: Verified at Ethereum block 25295092. EURSAFO is a UUPS proxy at 0x0990b149 (impl 0x13ae01cb, Token contract); authority() = PermissionManager proxy at 0x344278aff (ERC1967Proxy → PermissionManager impl 0xd3f5f152). PermissionManager deployed at block 19690257; initialization logs confirm: ADMIN group (group 0) → 0x4eaa52b6 (Safe 1.4.1, 8/3, no modules/guard); minter/burner access → two issuer-backend relayer proxies (0xa0769f7a, 0xe4880249). PermissionManager UUPS has no separate proxy admin; the ADMIN group itself gates upgradeToAndCall.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spiko announced Chainlink CCIP integration for regulated money-market fund tokens across multiple blockchains. EURSAFO therefore carries external CCIP validation assumptions instead of an issuer-only native route.
